title: Stocks Fall on AI Slowdown Fears, Oil Jitters Hit Sentiment
description:
US equity futures fall as leaders of the biggest AI firms propose slowing the technology’s development. Oil prices rise after Saudi Arabia closed a major crude pipeline following attacks. Amy Wu Silverman of RBC Capital Markets joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss how options markets are positioning. Bloomberg Contributor Adam Hodge of Bully Pulpit International discusses what to expect from the US midterm elections.
